content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The core of this infrastructure lies in its independence from conventional payment processors. Platforms like Gumroad charge hefty fees—up to 10% on sales—while our solution only incurs a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments. This difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921. This architecture is built to withstand the complexities of financial isolation, ensuring that you own everything from your customer data to your revenue. Sovereignty in your commerce stack translates into reliability and control.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start, gather the necessary tools for your deployment. You'll need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, access to Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account for payment processing. Set up a free Supabase or Google Sheets account for order storage, and ensure you have file storage ready on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery of digital products. These components will collectively form your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept the cryptocurrencies you want. Choose networks like BSC or Solana for low transaction fees. Next, implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your digital products. This setup allows you to process payments and instantly deliver products to customers without manual intervention. Test your pipeline thoroughly to ensure that transactions process smoothly and customers receive their purchases promptly.
Retain more revenue with a 0.5% transaction fee versus Gumroad's 10%.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to launch. Promote your digital products through social media, email newsletters, and online forums relevant to your audience. Direct potential customers to your hosted store link. When a transaction occurs, the NOWPayments integration will automatically verify the payment and trigger your delivery pipeline, ensuring that customers receive their products without delays. This process validates your setup and reinforces the reliability of your sovereign infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial launch, focus on scaling your offerings. Monitor your sales data to identify popular products, then expand your catalog accordingly. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates, to enhance your stack's capabilities. Consider implementing upselling strategies or creating bundles to increase average order value. The freedom of your infrastructure allows you to adjust and optimize without the constraints of a third-party platform.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate product delivery with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to tap into the power of crypto and start selling digital products without platform restrictions, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides everything you need to build your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to discover more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack that uses NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This allows you to accept payments directly while automating delivery without relying on platforms like PayPal or Stripe.

The best way is to create a sovereign stack using tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This configuration minimizes fees and gives you total control over your sales process.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers while accepting crypto payments without needing Gumroad or Payhip.
How do I ensure instant product delivery?
Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the process of product delivery. This configuration ensures that customers receive their purchases immediately upon payment confirmation.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges up to 10%. This fee structure allows you to retain more revenue from each sale.
Total ownership means no platform dependencies or monthly subscriptions.
